name: print_timeline
description: Print the timeline as its literal TSX projection (header with media table, pending count and rev, then <track> and item elements, one per line). Always print before editing; use from/lines to read part of a long timeline.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: apply_timeline
description: Apply an edit to the timeline as one undoable revision. Give `edits` (each oldText must occur exactly once in the printed timeline of `rev`; newText replaces it; empty newText deletes) with the `rev` from the header you edited, or a whole replacement `source`. Edits the person made meanwhile are merged. Returns what changed, conflicts and warnings, or the diagnostics that refused the edit.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: The rev from the printed header the edits were made against

edits.description: Text edits against the printed timeline

source.description: Complete replacement projection text (instead of edits)

prefer.description: Which side wins a conflict with edits the person made meanwhile (default file)

name: verify_timeline
description: Report problems: overlapping items, gaps on the main track, clips running past their source, missing or offline media, pending placeholders.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: undo_timeline
description: Undo your most recent change that is not undone yet (or your revision `rev`) as a new revision. Only your own changes are undone; edits the person or other agents made meanwhile stay. Refused with undo.conflict, listing the items, when a later change touched the same fields.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: One of your revisions to undo (default: your latest)

name: list_media
description: The project's media: id, name (usable as src), kind, duration, online/offline status and use count.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: add_media
description: Add files to a project by absolute path: each is probed, registered and placed as a clip (video/images on Main, audio on Audio, after the last clip unless `at` is given).

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

at.description: Start of the first clip in seconds

name: grab_frame
description: Decode one frame of a media item or file; returns it as an image.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

grid.description: Overlay a labelled grid in the frame's pixels from its centre, with safe-area boxes

name: filmstrip
description: Contact sheet of frames across a media file (or a range); returns the image and the frame times.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

storyboard.description: A storyboard instead: frames across the whole file, repeats dropped, at most 36 tiles with timecodes

name: detect_scenes
description: Hard cuts in a video: times (s) and scores.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

name: audio_levels
description: Peak and RMS level (dBFS) per bucket across an audio or video file.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

name: detect_silence
description: Ranges quieter than a threshold for at least a minimum length — candidates for cuts. `mode: "speech"` finds dead air instead: pauses that voice activity finds and that are `relativeDb` below the speaker's own level (music beds stay), per media in source seconds; the document is not changed.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

media.description: Media id, file name or path

padding.description: Seconds kept each side, default 0.15, 0–0.5 (speech mode)

relativeDb.description: dB below the speech level, default 12 (speech mode)

name: look
description: Render composited timeline frames (what the export will show) and return them as images, optionally with brightness stats.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

grid.description: Overlay a labelled grid in transform units (pixels from the canvas centre) with title-safe and action-safe boxes

storyboard.description: One storyboard sheet of the whole timeline instead: repeats dropped, at most 36 tiles, each with its timecode and the ids of the visible items

name: seek
description: Move the app's playhead to a time in seconds so the person sees that moment.

name: check_code
description: Check a code item's composition before (or after) applying it: transpiles the TSX, reports syntax errors, imports and unavailable globals with line:column, then renders frames at the start, middle and end and reports runtime errors, endless loops, unsupported elements and styles, console output and the slowest frame time. Pass the codeComposition object ({source, props?, assets?} or {template, props}).

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

name: ask_user
description: Ask the person a question when a choice is genuinely theirs (style, which take, what to cut). Offer 2-4 short options when you can. Blocks until they answer.

name: undo_my_changes
description: Undo every change of this session (scope session, the default) or of one turn (scope turn) as one new revision, keeping everyone else's edits. Refused with undo.conflict, listing the items, when a later change by someone else touched the same fields.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

turn.description: The turn id (default: the current turn)

name: edit_timeline
description: Run one edit verb as one revision (one undo step): split, trim, rippleTrim, rippleDelete, delete, insert, overwrite, lift, extract, closeGap, slip, slide, roll, move. Later items ripple on sync-locked tracks, linked items edit together, times snap to the frame grid. `request` is the edit as JSON, e.g. {"op":"rippleDelete","tracks":["a1"],"ranges":[{"start":12.3,"end":14}]} (seconds). Returns the plan and the printed lines of what changed; a refusal names a code and the culprit item ids. With `rev`, a request made against an older revision is moved through the ripples made since.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

rev.description: Revision the request was made against (default: the current one)

preview.description: Return the plan without applying it

name: list_models_local
description: List the local machine-learning models (id, purpose, licence, size in bytes, whether installed, folder). Models over 50 MB install only with the person's consent: in the app's Settings > Storage, or `ove models install <id> --yes` typed by the person.

name: get_transcript
description: The words said on the timeline, in timeline order: id (`<mediaId>@<sourceMs>`, stable across edits), text, timeline start and end in seconds, clip id, source times and a filler flag, with the project `rev` they were read at. Pages at 10,000 words (`offset`, `limit`). `segments: true` gives sentences instead. Media without a transcript are listed in `untranscribed`.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

clips.description: Only these clip ids (default: every clip with sound)

model.description: Only transcripts made with this speech model (tiny, base, small)

language.description: Only transcripts in this language (ISO 639-1), with `model`

name: remove_words
description: Cut words from the timeline as one revision: word ids from `get_transcript`, `ranges` of ids (`from` to `to` in timeline order) or exact phrases (`match`). Each cut keeps part of the natural pause (`pause`: tight 60 ms, balanced 150 ms, loose 320 ms), snaps its edges to the quietest point near the word, fades the seam, and later items close the gap; captions drop the cut words. Ids read at an older `rev` stay valid. `apply: false` returns the plan and the `timeline.tsx` diff without changing anything.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

match.description: Exact phrases; every occurrence is cut

pause.description: Pause kept at each seam (default balanced)

rev.description: Revision the ids were read at

name: remove_silence
description: Cut dead air from the timeline as one revision: pauses found with on-device voice activity that are at least `relativeDb` (default 12) below the speaker's own level and at least `minPause` long (default 0.5 s), keeping `padding` (default 0.15 s) on each side except at clip edges. Music beds and loud ambience stay. Needs the inference runtime (the person installs it in Settings > Storage). `apply: false` returns the plan and the `timeline.tsx` diff.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)

clips.description: Only these clip ids (default: every clip with sound)

name: find_fillers
description: Filler candidates on the timeline for review: listed filler words (`um`, `uh`, …) selected by default, context-dependent words (`like`, `you know`) flagged but not selected, and voiced sounds no word covers (after dead-air detection). Word candidates carry ids for `remove_words`. Nothing is cut.

project.description: Project name, id or bundle path (optional when the session has a project: the open one in the app, or the one set with use_project)
